title: Swoff Configuration
description: Configuration for the Swoff offline-first service worker system

framework.description: Detected frontend framework. Used to generate framework-specific hooks and adapters. Set automatically by `swoff init`. When a meta-framework is detected (nextjs, remix, etc.), navigation.mode and strategy defaults are auto-configured.

requestBatchWindowMs.description: Time window in ms to coalesce concurrent GET requests to the same URL before dispatching to the SW. 0 disables batching.

preventDefaultInstall.description: Prevent browser's native install prompt. When false, browser prompt shows naturally while event is captured. When true, prompt is suppressed and dev must call promptInstall() manually.

oneOf.description: "package": reads version from package.json. "hash": uses SHA-256 hash of generated SW content (deterministic, fixed SW URL).

autoActivate.description: Automatically activate newly registered service workers (skipWaiting). Only applies when a new version is registered — use with autoUpdate for fully silent updates, or wait for user consent then call handleUpdateApproved().

default.description: Default caching strategy for all requests

patterns.description: Custom cache strategies for specific URL patterns. Each value can be a strategy name string, or an object with strategy-specific options. Reactive-only fields (staleTime, refetchInterval, refetchOnReconnect, refetchOnFocus) are only valid with strategy 'reactive'.

staleTime.description: Stale time in seconds for reactive strategy. Cached data is considered fresh for this duration. After expiry, the SW serves the cached copy but triggers a background refresh. 0 = always stale. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchInterval.description: Auto-refetch interval in seconds for reactive strategy. The SW will periodically re-fetch this route in the background. 0 disables. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchOnReconnect.description: Refetch when the browser comes back online. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchOnFocus.description: Refetch when the browser tab gains focus. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

reactive.description: Reactive strategy global defaults. These apply to all routes using the 'reactive' strategy unless overridden per-route.

defaults.description: Default values for reactive strategy fields

staleTime.description: Global default stale time in seconds. Data is considered fresh for this long; after expiry, SW serves cached but triggers a background refresh. 0 = always stale.

refetchInterval.description: Global default auto-refetch interval in seconds. SW periodically re-fetches matching routes in the background. 0 disables.

refetchOnReconnect.description: Global default — refetch reactive entries when the browser comes back online.

refetchOnFocus.description: Global default — refetch reactive entries when the tab gains focus.

mode.description: Controls which requests are processed by the SW cache strategy system. 'all' processes every GET/HEAD request. 'explicit-only' only processes requests with X-SW-Cache-Strategy header (set automatically by fetchWithCache()).

clearRuntimeOnUpdate.description: Delete runtime cache on SW activate. Use as a security measure: when true, cached API responses are cleared on every SW update, preventing poisoned data from persisting.

maxRuntimeCacheAge.description: Maximum age in seconds for runtime cache entries. Entries older than this are evicted. 0 disables eviction. Default 2592000 (30 days).

normalizeKey.description: Normalize cache keys by lowercasing and sorting query params. Reduces cache fragmentation.

ignoreQueryParams.description: Query parameter names to ignore when matching cache keys. Useful for Analytics/UTM params that should not create separate cache entries.

timeout.description: Network fetch timeout in seconds. The SW wraps fetch() with an AbortController that aborts after this duration. On timeout or network error, a SW_NOTIFICATION is broadcast and the strategy falls through to its cache fallback.

mode.description: Navigation mode. 'spa': serve SPA fallback for unmatched navigations. 'default': passthrough (no special handling). 'network-first': try network, fall back to cache/offline. 'stale-while-revalidate': serve cached HTML instantly, refresh in background.

preload.description: Enable Navigation Preload API in the service worker. Reduces startup latency for navigation requests by allowing the SW to fetch while the page boots.

fallback.description: Fallback HTML for navigation requests. Used as the SPA shell when navigation mode is 'spa', and as the final fallback in the offline chain for all modes.

precacheRoutes.description: Additional routes to fetch and cache during SW install (e.g. ['/', '/about']). Useful for SSG routes or critical pages that should work offline on first visit. Glob patterns not supported — use exact paths.

offlineFallback.description: Path to a custom offline HTML page (e.g. '/offline.html'). Served when the network is unavailable and no cached version of the requested page exists. The path is precached at install time.

rules.description: Per-route navigation policies. Each rule defines a glob pattern with a policy and optional offline fallback page.

match.description: Glob pattern matching request paths (supports *, **, ?, {a,b}). Example: '/notes/**'

policy.description: Navigation policy for matching routes. 'cache-first': serve from precache immediately (never fetches). 'network-first': try network, fall back to cache/offline. 'network-only': always fetch (never cache). 'stale-while-revalidate': serve cached HTML instantly, refresh in background.

offlineFallback.description: Per-route offline fallback HTML path. Overrides the global offlineFallback for matching routes. Automatically precached at install time.

retry.description: Smart navigation retry configuration. When enabled, the SW starts a background retry loop when serving the ultimate offline fallback. On success, caches the response and broadcasts 'swoff:navigation-online' (client) or 'NAV_RETRY_SUCCESS' (SW postMessage).

enabled.description: Enable smart retry. When true, the SW periodically retries failed navigations in the background.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts before giving up.

refetchQueue.description: Background refetch queue configuration. Controls batching and retry behavior for stale cache refreshes.

batchSize.description: Max stale cache entries to refetch per batch

batchDelayMs.description: Delay in ms between batch cycles (rate limiting)

maxRetries.description: Max retries for background refetches (exponential backoff)

retryDelayMs.description: Base delay in ms for retry backoff (delay × 2^retryCount)

mutationQueue.description: Offline mutation queue configuration. Object-only (boolean shorthand not supported).

backgroundSync.description: Enable Background Sync API (Chrome/Edge only). Nests under mutationQueue because it requires mutation queue processing.

type.description: Auth adapter type — determines how Swoff communicates with your auth provider

routePaths.description: URL path prefixes that bypass SW caching at build time. Requests matching any of these paths return immediately in the fetch event listener, before any strategy resolution. Default: well-known auth routes.

tagInvalidation.description: Tag-based cache invalidation configuration. Object-only (boolean shorthand not supported).

crossTabSync.description: Cross-tab cache invalidation sync. When true, invalidation events broadcast to all open tabs.

debounceMs.description: Debounce window (ms) for coalescing rapid invalidations. When > 0, repeated INVALIDATE_TAG messages within the window are batched and processed once, reducing redundant cache scans.

skipPrefixes.description: URL path prefixes to skip during tag generation

patterns.description: Custom glob patterns for tag generation. Keys are URL patterns, values are tag template arrays.

singularization.description: Custom plural to singular mapping (e.g. {"categories": "category"}). Default strips trailing 's'.

cascading.description: Cascading tag dependencies. {"todos": ["categories"]} means invalidating 'todos' also invalidates 'categories'.

graphql.description: GraphQL client wrapper configuration. Object-only (boolean shorthand not supported).

enabled.description: Enable GraphQL wrapper with body-hash caching

endpoints.description: GraphQL API endpoints. Supports multiple endpoints — pass endpointIndex to fetchWithCache/useCachedFetch to select one.

realtime.description: Real-time features container. Push notifications and server-sent events for cache invalidation.

pushNotifications.description: Enable push notification subscription management. Generates realtime/notifications.ts with subscribe/unsubscribe helpers.

vapidPublicKey.description: VAPID public key for push subscription. Baked into the generated push handler at build time — the key is not needed at runtime.

serverPush.description: Server push event configuration (SSE or WebSocket). The service worker connects to a push endpoint and invalidates cache tags when the server signals data changes.

enabled.description: Enable server push event connection for real-time cache invalidation

type.description: Transport type: 'sse' (Server-Sent Events via fetch stream) or 'websocket'

endpoint.description: Push event endpoint URL (e.g., /api/events for SSE, wss://example.com/events for WebSocket)

reconnectDelayMs.description: Delay in ms before reconnecting after connection loss

swFilename.description: Service worker output filename without version suffix (e.g. 'sw' produces sw-v1.2.3.js)

precacheDirs.description: Additional directories to scan for precache assets. Keys are filesystem paths from project root. Values are objects with prefix and optional filter/transform options. Example: { ".next/static": { "prefix": "/_next/static" }, ".next/server/app": { "prefix": "", "extensions": [".html"], "stripExtension": true, "stripSuffixes": ["index"] } }

prefix.description: URL prefix to serve assets under

extensions.description: Only include files with these extensions (e.g. [".html", ".json"])

stripExtension.description: Remove the file extension from the cached URL key

stripSuffixes.description: Strip these path segments before the extension (e.g. ["index", "page"]). After extension stripping, each matching suffix is removed: /index → /, /about/index → /about/. Trailing slashes are then cleaned up for consistent cache key matching.
